For investors, the deal highlights how electricity shortages are pushing AI developers to commit billions beyond chips and computing facilities. Controlling power equipment could help Anthropic
avoid delays, but adds to its financial commitments as it prepares for a possible stock market listing.

The purchase reflects a broader effort by technology companies to secure electricity directly as equipment backlogs grow. The Financial Times described it as the largest known single purchase of power-generation equipment by an AI lab.
